**Finding submitted: INSURANCE — missing (fallback cure).**

- **Investigation:** Document-wide search for "insurance" returned zero hits; I read all 75 paragraphs of the single section. No insurance covenant exists in Term/Termination (p0015–p0022), Warranties (p0029–p0045), Indemnification (p0046–p0055), or General Provisions (p0063–p0073).
- **Why it matters:** Kubient is a hosting/ad-serving vendor that expressly undertakes "collection, maintenance, management and storage of visitor information (data)" (p0035), so the rule expects insurance; its total absence fails even the fallback.
- **Cure:** One `insert_after` at p0073 adding new general provision 14(j) with exactly the two fallback elements — E&O of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber liability of not less than USD 2,000,000. I deliberately omitted the preferred CGL limits, workers' compensation and certificates, and the model language's "at its own expense" and one-year tail, as no selected element requires them.
